author: Inside Edition
description: A "mysterious brown substance" was sprayed at Congresswoman Ilhan Omar by a man before he was wrestled to the ground by security. Omar's staff urged her to leave the town hall event and get checked out at a hospital but she was determined to carry on. According to published reports, the substance was apple cider vinegar. The assailant has been identified as Anthony Kazmierczak. He has two previous DUI convictions and appears to be a supporter of President Donald Trump, according to his Facebook page.
title: What Was In The Syringe Sprayed At Congresswoman Ilhan Omar?

author: Inside Edition
description: Former IRS Agent Brendan Banfield took the stand in his own defense at his murder trial. Banfield is accused of stabbing his wife to death in a plot to begin a new life with the family nanny. Banfield and the nanny are accused of luring an unsuspecting man to the house with an offer of sex, then shooting him when he stepped into the bedroom, and then stabbing Banfield's wife.The nanny pled guilty to manslaughter. Banfield, who has pleaded not guilty, faces life in prison if convicted.
title: Brendan Banfield Takes Stand In Own Defense At His Murder Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: Drivers across the United States are finding themselves slipping and sliding. Inside Edition got some tips on how to drive on icy roads. The first rule is to stay calm. If you are going down a hill, tap the brake lightly. Inside Edition's expert says if you feel yourself about to spin out of control, take your foot off the gas and do not brake. Many people are still trying to dig their cars out of snow after last weekend's winter storm.
title: Tips On How To Drive On Icy Roads

author: Inside Edition
description: First Lady Melania Trump rang the opening bell at the New York Stock Exchange Wednesday morning to prompt her new self-titled documentary "Melania." Amazon paid over $40 million for the rights and another $35 million for marketing and promotion. The film will be shown in 1,400 theaters. Advance ticket sales are said to be pretty weak. A private, black-tie screening was held at the White House last week,  but there were no advance screenings for critics.
title: Melania Trump Promotes Her New Self-Titled Documentary

author: Inside Edition
description: Colorado Parks and Wildlife says an American Bald Eagle was found at the Croke Reservoir in the city of Northglenn on January 12. It was taken to a wildlife rehabilitation facility for treatment where rescuers learned it had a ball bearing lodged in its wing. Now officials say they want to know what happened. Was it an accident? An Investigation is ongoing. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Bald Eagle Recovering After Being Shot In Colorado Park

author: Inside Edition
description: Social media is flooded with videos of so-called "silver influencers." One grandmother, who goes by "Grama Sandy" on TikTok is a big hit for her stunts. She even went toe-to-toe with actor Jeff Goldblum in a race. Silver influencer Sandra Sallin, 85, is also a hit. Her content focuses on women feeling better at any age. She says being a silver influencer got her a lot of respect from her grandchildren.
title: So-Called 'Silver Influencers' Are Getting Huge Hits On Social Media

author: Inside Edition
description: TV talk show giant Maury Povich was at the center of real-life paternity dramas, revealing the results of DNA tests his male guests had taken. The kids are being called "Maury Babies" and there are thousands of them. Inside Edition spoke to Melissa Santillan, who was 17 years old when she appeared on the show and her now 25-year-old daughter Reanna. Povich is among the daytime TV hosts featured in a three-part ABC documentary "Dirty Talk: When Daytime Talk Shows Ruled TV."
title: Where Are The Kids Who Were On 'Maury' Now?

author: Inside Edition
description: Dogs have a complicated relationship with cold, snowy weather. For some dogs, it's a struggle, for others, they can't get enough of it. According to the American Veterinary Medical Association, if temperatures fall below 20 degrees, your dog could be at risk for hypothermia and frostbite and should only go outside for quick potty trips. Dogs owners should watch for shivering, anxiety, lifting paws, or slowing down as warning signs that their dog should get out of the cold.
title: Tips To Keep Your Dog Safe In The Winter

author: Inside Edition
description: She is still working at age 92. Muriel Connick is a sales associate at a Burlington store in Pompano Beach, Florida. She says after a lifetime of hard work, she still couldn't afford to retire. Shopper April Steele was shocked to see the elderly woman wheeling clothing racks at the store and clearing out the dressing room. Steele is now organizing a GoFundMe account that has raised almost $60,000 for Connick, money she says she needs to pay her bills and arrange repairs around her house.
title: GoFundMe Raises Money To Help 92-Year-Old Woman Retire
